questions.q: How do you enter the CLI?
options: The cli command in the OSD menu
The CLI tab or the # character
Through the OSD menu with the sticks
A stick combination on the radio
questions.explain: The CLI tab in the configurator or the # character in a terminal switches the FC into command-line mode.

questions.q: What does the resource command do?
options: Resets the settings of the selected resource
questions.explain: Resource remapping means moving a function to another pad, e.g. a motor to a free output.

options: reboot without save — it gets written at startup
questions.explain: set changes the value in memory; save writes it to flash and reboots.

options: The RPM filter version and its status
questions.explain: get searches by substring — handy for viewing a group of settings.

questions.q: Can you paste a diff all from another major version?
options: Only on F7 boards and only in dump format
questions.explain: Parameter names and meanings change; carry settings between versions section by section, re-reading them.

questions.q: How do you save a motor direction reversal via DShot commands?
options: resource MOTOR 1 reverse, then save and reboot
Enters DFU for flashing over USB
questions.explain: It mounts the flash as a USB drive for pulling logs; bl is for DFU.

questions.q: What is the BUILD KEY from status for?
options: Checking and reproducing the firmware contents from the cloud build
questions.explain: The build key shows which options are enabled, and the build can be reproduced.
